$comment: Known-capability registry consumed read-only by the Rust validator (F2-07). NON-NORMATIVE default set: which capabilities exist, and the Core-versus-extension distinction, remain OPEN (decision record §58; spec/core/core-vs-extension.md). This file fixes no normative closure; it is the checked-in default a declared capability is resolved against. A declared identifier absent here is capability.unknown; a missing or unreadable registry is a loud failure, never an implicit 'all known'.
